extension.description: IntelliJ/WebStorm-style npm run configurations: a run selector in the status bar, a Run/Debug Configurations dialog with detected Node.js runtimes and package managers, Ctrl+R to run and import from IntelliJ.
debugger.label: npm (Run Configuration)
attr.packageJson: package.json whose directory is the working directory.
attr.command: Package manager command: run, start, test, install…
attr.arguments: Extra arguments. With npm, `--` is added before them automatically.
attr.nodeRuntime: Absolute path of the node binary. Empty: project default (.nvmrc, `runConfigurations.defaultNodeRuntime` or PATH).
attr.packageManager: npm, pnpm, yarn, bun or a path. Empty: from the packageManager field or the lockfile.
attr.allowMultiple: Start a new instance instead of restarting the running one.
snippet.label: npm: Run Configuration (IntelliJ-style)
snippet.description: Runs a package.json script with a chosen Node.js runtime and package manager.
settings.defaultNodeRuntime: Node binary used when a configuration's **Node runtime** is *Project* and there is no `.nvmrc`/`.node-version`. Empty: the `node` on PATH.
settings.showStatusBar: Show the run configuration selector and the Run/Debug/Stop buttons in the status bar.
settings.offerIntellijImport: Offer to import IntelliJ npm run configurations (`.idea/workspace.xml`, `.idea/runConfigurations`, `.run`) when a workspace has none.
